title: Declared evaluation dependencies reported by check:freshness, with a backlog rule
goal: A generic, tool-agnostic way for any project to surface unrun test content from its evaluation dependencies
acceptance: `.harness.json` `evaluations: [{name, pending}]`, where `pending` is a project command; absent means no change
check:freshness runs each command with a timeout, prints its listed cases as a finding and never fails the session on a command error (reports it instead)
BACKLOG-RULES and AGENTS: a pending case keeps an open record until a run covers it; runs of real models stay owner-approved; APPLY adoption step
No reference to any specific evaluation tool in core
privacy: Command output is printed only; nothing is stored or sent.
validation: tools/test-tools.mjs fixtures: no setting, pending listed, nothing pending, command error, timeout
escalation: Making pending cases fail CI (not only warn) is an owner decision per project

effort.basis: Published v5.2.0 after PR #110 green CI 43019509190 and independent review; initial estimate 1 focused day retained in Git.
